title.zh: 【Bitcoin Core 发布 v32.1 版本】
title.en: 【Bitcoin Core 发布 v32.1 版本】

current_state.zh: Bitcoin Core released v32.1, adding PoW defense for Tor hidden services, switching transaction relay rate limiting to a global backlog model to reduce memory and CPU pressure, private broadcast fixes and limits, and raising the default maximum automatic peer connections from 125 to 200.
current_state.en: Bitcoin Core released v32.1, adding PoW defense for Tor hidden services, switching transaction relay rate limiting to a global backlog model to reduce memory and CPU pressure, private broadcast fixes and limits, and raising the default maximum automatic peer connections from 125 to 200.
